release_notes: `broker/breeze_ticker.py`: every Breeze WS option tick was silently dropped — `_parse_tick()` read a `stock_code` field a live `on_ticks` payload doesn't send (only `stock_name`, a display name with no code map), so every option tick raised `KeyError` and only the NIFTY 50 spot tick ever landed in the cache. `ltp()` silently fell back to REST for every option leg since `ws_ticks` shipped in `0.37.5`. `_parse_tick` now matches a tick back to the `subscribe_feeds()` call that requested it, by `(expiry_date, strike_price, right)`, instead of trusting an identity field on the tick. `_check_health()`'s `breeze.ws_ticks_parse_broken` watchdog never fired despite the above — it was keyed off a global cache-staleness diff that a healthy spot tick kept masking indefinitely. Now driven off a dedicated last-parse-failure timestamp. `BreezeTickerService`'s shared sqlite connection (`check_same_thread=False`) hit `cannot rollback - no transaction is active` under concurrent `on_ticks` dispatch — writes are now serialized with a lock.
